title: Cloud Nine: the 9th Anniversary
subtitle: Physique 57 India · April 2027 · four acts, eight offers, twelve activations and a midnight close
summary: April 2027 target: ₹109.6L across the four locations, against ₹90.7L in April 2026 — the first ₹1 crore month in Physique 57 India’s history. Named offers carry ₹80.5L (73%); the rest is full-price trade. April has to win on excitement and on economics: two products that exist only this month, a flash pack you can earn with a plank, a wheel you can double, numbered annual seats, a month of events, and no offer above 25% effective.
idea: Cloud Nine: nine years, one month, no chill. April is a party in four acts. The pre-party rewards March renewers with first pick; anniversary week runs a moment a day; the haunting sends the lapsed list its own obituary; and the month closes with the Golden Glute Awards and a midnight Lock-In. Every reward is something to do or to show off — a key, a seat, a stamp, a spin — which costs less than a discount and brings clients into the studio, which is what makes them renew.

why.head: April 2026 was bought with discount
why.body: Kemps Corner’s April 2026 was a record ₹50.0L, but its average discount was 30.1% (April 2025: 14.1%) and anniversary codes ran at 40–48% effective. Bandra discounted more (25.3%) and still earned less than in April 2025.

why.head: April buyers do not all come back
why.body: Between May and October 2026, 57% of Kemps Corner’s April buyers bought again, 51% at Bandra, 68% at Kenkere House and 41% at the pop-ups. The doubled wheel, the passports and the May follow-ups are built to fix this.

why.head: Usage drives renewal
why.body: Clients who use 75% or more of their sessions renew at around 80–86%; those under a quarter renew at 30–40%. Events that make people book classes are the best retention tool there is.

why.head: Scarcity beats discount
why.body: A numbered, one-month-only product gives people a reason to buy now without cutting the price of the core memberships.

why.head: March waits for April
why.body: March is one of the weakest months at every studio. Platinum Hour makes renewing in March the way to get the anniversary first.

offers.name: Moving In Together (The 9-Month Lease)
offers.headline: Nine years in, we’re ready to move in together. 99 keys. No second batch.
offers.details: A 9-Month Unlimited that exists only in April: Mumbai ₹1,44,999 (a 6-Month plus a 3-Month cost ₹1,71,570), Kenkere ₹1,02,999 (₹1,24,425). 9 freezes (min 3 days each), the anniversary hoodie, a numbered brass studio key and your name on the Lease Wall. 99 numbered keys across Kwality and Supreme HQ, 39 at Kenkere; a live counter on the studio screens.
offers.message: Nine years in, we’re ready to move in together. The 9-Month Lease: 9 months unlimited, 9 freezes, the anniversary hoodie and a numbered brass key. 99 keys in Mumbai, 39 in Bengaluru. When they’re gone, they’re gone.
offers.job: The biggest ticket of the month, carrying members to January 2028.
offers.why: A numbered, one-month-only product gives people a reason to buy now without cutting the price of the core memberships. April 2026 was bought with 40–48% codes; scarcity sells the long plan at 17.5–20% instead.
offers.audience: Members ready for a long commitment and returning clients who want the best price of the year.
offers.rules: 17.5% Mumbai / 20.0% Bengaluru effective (hoodie at list; freezes have no cash value). 99 / 39 numbered keys, no second batch. April only.
offers.kpi: Keys sold vs 99 / 39; 6M+ share of April membership revenue (target 50%).

offers.name: Club Nine: The Founders’ Table
offers.headline: Nine numbered seats per studio. Founder perks for a year.
offers.details: 9 numbered Annual Unlimited seats per studio at the standard 20% (₹1,75,560 / ₹1,24,992) with the annual perks doubled: 4 privates, 8 guest passes, 2 hosted classes, monthly trainer check-ins, a numbered jacket, your name on the Club Nine wall and 48-hour priority booking all year. Unveiled at the Birthday Bash on Sat 17 Apr.
offers.message: Nine seats. Nine years. Club Nine is an annual membership with the perks doubled: 4 privates, 8 guest passes, priority booking all year and a numbered jacket. Nine per studio, and then the table is full.
offers.job: Sell annuals at list-minus-20% by making them a status, not a discount.
offers.why: Annual buyers are the most valuable members in the book; a numbered seat with doubled perks costs less than a deeper price and gives them something to show off.
offers.audience: Members on 3-Month or longer plans; annual renewers.
offers.rules: Annual cap 25% (doubled perks at list). 9 seats per studio.
offers.kpi: Seats sold (9 per studio); annual share of April renewals.

offers.name: Spin Class (Literally)
offers.headline: Renew, then spin. Every spin wins. Feeling brave? Double it.
offers.details: Renew 1 Month or a 12-class pack in April at 10% off (₹18,215 / ₹17,719; Kenkere ₹13,136 / ₹11,813; pop-up 10-pack ₹7,655) and spin the Wheel of Nine. Published odds: +1 class 30%, smoothie 20%, guest pass 15%, grip socks 10%, +3 days 10%, extra freeze 8%, 30-min private 5%, P57 tote 1.5%, a free month 0.5%. Then choose: keep it, double it by booking 9 classes in your first 21 days, or donate it to a friend as a guest pass.
offers.message: Renew in April and spin the Wheel of Nine: every spin wins. Then decide: keep your prize, double it, or gift it to a friend. Odds are on the wall, because we’re not that kind of casino.
offers.job: Full-price-adjacent renewals with a prize everyone talks about.
offers.why: Clients who use 75%+ of their sessions renew at 80–86%. The doubling option pays the prize only when the member books the classes that make them renew again; the expected value of a spin is ≈₹1,900 Mumbai / ₹1,350 Bengaluru.
offers.audience: Members renewing 1 Month or a 12-class pack.
offers.rules: One spin per renewal; published odds; doubled prizes credited only once the 9 classes are attended. ≈19.5% effective on the expected value.
offers.kpi: April renewal yield vs April 2026; share of spins doubled (target 35%).

offers.name: Party Crasher Pass
offers.headline: It’s our 9th birthday and you’re invited. 3 classes for ₹999.
offers.details: Mumbai: 3 classes in 9 days for ₹999, any format, including a Birthday Bash party class (17–18 Apr). Kenkere: 3 Barre classes for ₹699 (replaces the 50% intro in April; counts as the once-in-a-lifetime 2-for-1). Pop-ups: 2 classes for ₹999. The pass price is credited against a first 1 Month or 12-class pack bought within 72 hours of class 3, on top of the standard 15% (1 Month nets ₹16,204 / ₹11,707). Buy within 9 hours of class 3 and you hit the Impulse Buzzer: confetti, applause, name on the Reckless Decisions board.
offers.message: It’s our 9th birthday and you’re invited: 3 classes for ₹999 (Kenkere ₹699), birthday party class included. Love it? The ₹999 comes off your first month. Decide fast and you get to hit the big red buzzer.
offers.job: Bring April’s traffic in through a party, and convert it inside 72 hours.
offers.why: A booked sequence of classes is what converts; the party class gives newcomers the best room of the year, and the buzzer turns a sale into a show for whoever is waiting.
offers.rules: One per phone number. Credit valid 72 hours after class 3. Standard 15% only.
offers.kpi: Pass → member (target 35%); buzzer hits (bought within 9 hours).

offers.name: Faking Your Own Death Didn’t Work
offers.headline: We wrote your obituary. You’re not getting out of it that easily.
offers.details: Lapsed 61 days–3 years get an obituary postcard (“Here lies a perfectly good plank”). It is the ticket to the candle-lit Séance Class on Thu 15 Apr. Come back on the standard 15% on 1 Month, a 12-class pack or 3 Months, plus a bonus for every year since your first class (max 3): +1 class on packs, +1 day on unlimited. Photo at the Back From the Dead frame; your row at the Throwback Reunion (Sat 24 Apr).
offers.message: We wrote your obituary. It was moving. Unfortunately for you, you’re invited back: 15% off, a bonus for every year you’ve been with us, and a candle-lit Séance Class to rise from the dead.
offers.job: Win back lapsed clients with a story they want to post.
offers.why: Lapsed clients already know the product; what they need is a moment and a reason that is not just a discount. A personal postcard with a dated class beats a generic reminder.
offers.rules: Lapsed 61 days–3 years. Standard lapsed 15% + loyalty-year bonus (max 3) = ≤20% effective.
offers.kpi: Postcards → Séance Class attendance; reactivations (target +30% vs Apr-26).

offers.name: Plus One, Plus Nine
offers.headline: Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.
offers.details: Any active member whose never-been friend buys in April gets +9 days (pack members: +2 classes). Three buying friends = a free month. The friend gets the standard 15% and a Cloud Nine tote. Bring Your Barre-stie day (Thu 8 Apr): every member gets a free guest pass.
offers.message: Bring a friend to the party: if they join, you get 9 extra days. Bring three and the next month is on us. They get 15% off and a Cloud Nine tote.
offers.job: Turn the anniversary into the year’s biggest referral month.
offers.why: Referrals convert at 22–76% against 3.8–5.7% for website leads. A tier at three friends gives the super-connectors a reason to keep going.
offers.audience: Current members bringing a never-been friend.
offers.rules: Friend must be new to P57. Member reward is acquisition cost, paid only on a purchase.
offers.kpi: Referral buyers (target 2× April 2026); members reaching three.

offers.name: The 9:09 Panic Attack
offers.headline: Plank for your price. Or wait for 9:09 and panic with everyone else.
offers.details: The Limited Edition 9-Class Pack (99 days to use it) exists only in April. Plank Your Price at the desk: hold 57 seconds and it is ₹12,999 (Kenkere ₹8,699), 1:57 for ₹12,249 (₹8,199), 2:57 for the floor, ₹11,499 (₹7,699). On Fri 9 Apr, two 99-minute windows from 9:09 am and 9:09 pm give everyone the floor price, no plank needed: siren in studio, countdown on Instagram. Pop-ups: a 9-class pack at ₹6,499 in the same windows.
offers.message: Plank for your price: hold it for 57 seconds and the 9-Class Pack is ₹12,999; hold for 2:57 and it’s ₹11,499. Or wait for 9:09 on 9 April, when everyone gets the floor price for 99 minutes. Panic responsibly.
offers.job: The anniversary’s entry product and its loudest moment.
offers.why: A price you earn with your body is the most Physique 57 thing there is, and every plank at the desk is a show for whoever is waiting. The floor price (23.7% / 24.0%) sits inside the 25% spot cap, and plan revenue is counted at the floor.
offers.audience: Everyone: members, pack buyers and newcomers.
offers.rules: Spot offer, ≤25% effective at the floor price. Two packs per person. April only; no anniversary prices after 30 Apr.
offers.kpi: Packs sold in the two 9:09 windows; pack → membership by June.

offers.name: The Cloud Nine 90
offers.headline: Ninety classes. One year. Zero commitment issues.
offers.details: 90 classes valid for 12 months: Mumbai ₹1,34,999 (₹1,500 a class; 90 singles cost ₹1,74,825 at list, so 22.8% off), Bengaluru ₹99,999 (₹1,111 a class against ₹1,27,575, 21.6% off). April only, any format.
offers.message: Ninety classes, one year, zero commitment issues: the Cloud Nine 90 works out to ₹1,500 a class. April only.
offers.job: Lock in a year of revenue from the heaviest pack buyers.
offers.why: The Anniversary Big 85 Flex sold 4 times at Kemps Corner and once at Kenkere House in April 2026; this replaces it at a price inside the bulk cap.
offers.kpi: Packs sold; classes used per month of the pack.

acts.name: The pre-party
acts.line: Tease it, reward March renewers with first pick, launch loud on 1 April, hand out the passports.
events: Teaser: “Something’s turning 9.” Countdown sticker on every mirror; nothing else explained.
Curiosity before the price list exists.
Platinum Hour: 48-hour early access for everyone who renewed in March. First pick of numbered keys (001 goes to the first Platinum member through the door) and the first Club Nine seats.
Rewards March commitment; sells the first keys before launch.

Launch: the “Nine Years in Ninety Seconds” film, then the April Fools’ price list (“₹57 lifetime membership”) that turns into the real one at noon. The 9-Month Lease and the 9-Class Pack go on sale; the Impulse Buzzer goes live at every desk.
The loudest first day of the year; explains how to play.
Blind Date With a Class: format and trainer secret until you walk in.
Members try a class they would never book; first passport stamp.
Nine Lives Passports handed out: nine experiences to collect in April (Throwback, Plank of Fame, a Lab or powerCycle class, Séance, Birthday Bash, Reunion, a new trainer, a friend, the Awards).
Attendance across the month: collect what you enjoy, no class count.

acts.name: Anniversary week
acts.line: Seven days, seven moments: the wheel, the throwback, the plank-off, best friends, the 9:09 panic and the first birthday party.
events: The Wheel of Nine opens: renew, spin, keep, double or donate.
Renewals with a prize everyone talks about.
Throwback Class: the 2018 playlist and the original choreography, taught by the longest-serving trainer.
Nostalgia for long-time members; the best content of the month.
Plank of Fame: a studio plank-off. The top 9 at each studio win a private and a year on the wall; everyone gets their Plank Your Price time.
Bragging rights; introduces privates and the 9-Class Pack.
Bring Your Barre-stie: a free guest pass for every member; Plus One, Plus Nine pays out on any friend who buys.
The 9:09 Panic Attack: siren, countdown and the floor price for 99 minutes from 9:09 am and again from 9:09 pm.
The month’s biggest sales spike, on the entry product.
Kenkere Birthday Class with pop-up regulars invited from Copper + Cloves and Plash Pilates.
Bengaluru’s own party; turns pop-up regulars into Kenkere visitors.
Trainer Swap Sunday: Mumbai trainers swap studios for the day; a Mumbai guest trainer at Kenkere.
A new face for every regular; cross-studio visits.

acts.name: The haunting
acts.line: The lapsed list gets its obituary, gold envelopes hide in the studios, and the birthday weekend arrives.
events: Hidden 9s: nine gold envelopes hidden in each studio each week (guest passes, smoothies, grip socks, one private). Found it? Post it.
Footfall and Stories every day of the fortnight.
Obituary postcards land with the lapsed list: “Here lies a perfectly good plank.” WhatsApp version the same day.
The winback with a story people screenshot.
Séance Class: candle-lit, the postcard is the ticket; the Back From the Dead photo frame by the door.
Winback in person; the 15% comeback offer after class.
Club Nine Unveiling + Birthday Bash: the nine numbered seats revealed, DJ class, cake; Party Crasher Pass holders get the party class.
Status for annual buyers; the best room of the year for newcomers.
The anniversary: ‘9 at 9’ — nine trainers, one class at 9 am. Then the Time Capsule: members write a note to open in April 2028.
The emotional peak; a 2028 renewal conversation already booked.
Founders’ Hour: nine years in nine stories, live, with a trainer Q&A (studio and Instagram Live).
Brand story; keeps week three warm.

acts.name: Awards & Lock-In
acts.line: The Throwback Reunion and the Golden Glute Awards, the last keys, and a midnight close with no extension.
events: Throwback Reunion (a row for every cohort, Class of 2018 to Class of 2026), then the Golden Glute Awards: member-voted categories and a trainer roast.
Community and content; every winner is a renewal conversation.
Last call: live key counter on every screen and Story; Club Nine seats left, by studio.
The Lock-In: last-day desk hours to 10 pm, the final keys, and anniversary prices close at midnight. No extension, no second batch.
Deadline pressure on the biggest tickets; price integrity for May.

activations.name: The Impulse Buzzer

activations.name: Wheel of Nine (double-or-donate)
activations.drama: Spin after an April renewal. Keep the prize, double it by booking 9 classes in the first 21 days, or donate it to a friend as a guest pass. Published odds on the wall.

activations.name: Plank Your Price
activations.drama: Hold a plank at the desk: 57 seconds, 1:57 or 2:57 sets the 9-Class Pack price. Every attempt is a show for whoever is waiting.

activations.name: Keys and the Lease Wall
activations.drama: 99 numbered brass keys in Mumbai, 39 in Bengaluru. Every buyer’s name goes on the Lease Wall; a live counter on the studio screens.

activations.name: The Club Nine wall
activations.drama: Nine numbered seats per studio, unveiled at the Birthday Bash; jackets numbered 1–9; priority booking all year.

activations.name: Obituaries, Séance & the Resurrection frame
activations.drama: Obituary postcards to the lapsed list, a candle-lit Séance Class, and a Back From the Dead photo frame for every returner (posted with permission).
activations.sells: Faking Your Own Death Didn’t Work

activations.name: Bring Your Barre-stie
activations.drama: A free guest pass for every member on 8 April; three buying friends earn a free month.

activations.name: The 9:09 Panic Attack
activations.drama: Siren, countdown, two 99-minute windows on 9 April. The floor price for everyone, no plank needed.

activations.name: Nine Lives Passport
activations.drama: Nine April experiences to collect. Five stamps enter the Awards draw; all nine get a passport pin. No purchase needed and nothing is unlocked by a class count.

activations.name: Hidden 9s
activations.drama: Gold envelopes hidden in each studio, nine a week, 12–25 April.

activations.name: Golden Glute Awards
activations.drama: Member-voted: Front Row Forever, Loudest Shaker, Grip Sock Icon, Comeback of the Year, Plank Champion, Best Studio Duo, Trainer of the Year, plus the trainer roast.

activations.name: Time Capsule
activations.drama: A note from every member, sealed on 18 April and opened at the 10th anniversary, each one a renewal conversation in April 2028.

kpis.target: ₹109.6L across the four locations (+21% on April 2026)
Under 15% of gross sales at every studio (April 2026: Kemps Corner 30.1%, Bandra 25.3%, Kenkere 8.8%)
At least half of April membership revenue from 3-Month, 6-Month, 9-Month and Annual plans
17 of the 9-Month Leases sold (11 Kemps Corner, 4 Bandra, 2 Kenkere); 9 Club Nine seats
351 new buyers; Party Crasher pass → member 35%
April 2027 buyers who buy again May–Oct: targets by studio below

risks.mitigation: One reward per purchase; offers, the wheel and the flash price never combine; no desk overrides above the plan price.

risks.risk: The keys do not sell out
risks.mitigation: No second batch and no price cut. Move the conversation to Club Nine or a 6-Month after 20 April.

risks.risk: Lead volume (Kemps Corner needs 941 April leads; its best month had far fewer)
risks.mitigation: Fund April paid media explicitly, push Barre-stie day and Plus One, Plus Nine; review leads weekly against the funnel.
No anniversary price after 30 April; May offers reward April buyers who attend, they do not extend April pricing.
A head trainer owns each event; no more than one event a day in week two; rota published by 28 March.

guardrails: Cap: no April offer goes above 25% effective, counting every bonus at list. Cash stays ≤20% except Club Nine (annual), the 9:09 floor price (spot) and the Cloud Nine 90 (bulk).
One reward per purchase: offers, the wheel and the flash price do not combine. Passport and game prizes are attendance rewards, not a discount on a sale.
Scarcity is real: 99 keys in Mumbai and 39 in Bengaluru means exactly that. No second batch.
Price integrity: no anniversary prices after 30 April.
Every redemption is tagged with its offer ID (O27-13…18, O27-53, O27-54) so April can be judged offer by offer.

afterActions.head: No Graceful Exit (May)
afterActions.body: April buyers who attend 12+ classes in their first 30 days are offered the upgrade to a 3-Month with a private session.

afterActions.head: Doubled wheels
afterActions.body: Every member who chose to double gets a trainer check-in at day 10; doubled prizes are credited once the 9 classes are attended.

afterActions.head: Passport follow-up
afterActions.body: Members with fewer than 3 stamps get a trainer call in the first week of May.

afterActions.head: Resurrection follow-up
afterActions.body: Everyone who came to the Séance Class but did not buy gets a personal message within 7 days.

afterActions.head: Time Capsule
afterActions.body: Opened at the 10th anniversary in April 2028, with a renewal conversation for every member who wrote one.
